versions.content: TCP retransmission handling Status: DRAFT The TcpIp shall support the Retransmission Strategy with clamped exponential back- off with base 2 in TCP by using the configuration parameters TcpIpTcpRetransmis- sionTimeout, TcpIpTcpMaxRetransmissionTimeout and TcpIpTcpMaxRtx as defined in ETF RFC 1122: • 4.2.2.15 Retransmission Timeout • 4.2.3.1 Retransmission Timeout Calculation while excluding Jacobson’s and Karn’s algorithm for measuring round time trip (RTT) and calculation of the retransmission timeout (RTO) from it.
